chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ali ibn Hassan, from one of our companions who said:

I was present with Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him), and Harun the Caliph, and Isa ibn Ja'far, and Ja'far ibn Yahya, in Medina. They had come to the grave of the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family). So Harun said to Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him), 'Proceed!' But he refused. So Harun proceeded, greeted, and stood to the side.

And Isa ibn Ja'far said to Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him), 'Proceed!' But he refused. So Isa proceeded, greeted, and stood with Harun. Then Ja'far said to Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him), 'Proceed!' But he refused. So Ja'far proceeded, greeted, and stood with Harun.

And Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him) proceeded, so he said: 'Peace be upon you, O my father! I ask Allah, Who chose you and selected you and guided you and guided through you, that He send blessings upon you.'
So Harun said to Isa, 'Did you hear what he said?' He said, 'Yes'. So Harun said, 'I testify that he is truly his father.'

key_terms.أَبَاهْ: O my father (a term of lineage and affection used by the Imam)

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali ibn Musa (as) say to the Prophet at his grave that convinced Caliph Harun al-Rashid of his lineage?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Al-Kafi* highlights the Imam's deliberate humility and distinct spiritual status by declining to precede the Caliph, thereby emphasizing that his connection to the Prophet is ontological rather than merely ceremonial. The specific address 'Ya Abah' (O my father) underscores the Shia doctrine of the Imam as the true inheritor of the Prophet's spiritual and physical lineage, a point Harun al-Rashid immediately recognized as divine truth. This narrative serves as a foundational proof for the Imam's unique authority and his role as the living continuation of the Prophetic mission.

en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ali Bin Hassan, from one of our companions who said,

‘I was present with Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> the 1<sup>st</sup> (7<sup>th</sup> Imam<sup>asws</sup>), and Haroun (Al Rasheed) the Caliph, and Isa Bin Ja’far, and Ja’far Bin Yahya, at Al-Medina, and they had come to the grave of the Prophet<sup>saww</sup>. So Haroun said to Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup>, ‘Proceed!’ But, he<sup>asws</sup> refused. So Haroun proceeded and greeted, and stood nearby.

And Isa Bin ja’far said to Abu Al Hassan<sup>asws</sup>, ‘Proceed’. But he<sup>asws</sup> refused. So Isa proceeded and greeted, and paused alongside Haroun. So Ja’far said to Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup>, ‘Proceed’. But he<sup>asws</sup> refused. So Ja’far proceeded and paused alongside Haroun.

And Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> proceeded, so he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The greetings be upon you<sup>saww</sup>, O father<sup>saww</sup>! I<sup>asws</sup> ask Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Who Chose you<sup>saww</sup>, and Appointed you<sup>saww</sup>, and Guided you<sup>saww</sup>, and Guided through you<sup>saww</sup>, that He<sup>azwj</sup> should Send Blessings upon you<sup>saww</sup>’.
So Haroun said to Isa, ‘Did you hear what he<sup>asws</sup> said?’ He said, ‘Yes’. So Haroun said, ‘I testify that he<sup>saww</sup> is his<sup>asws</sup> father<sup>saww</sup>, truly’.
en.sarwar: 8. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Ali ibn Hassan from certain individuals of our people who have said the following:

“I was present when abu al-Hassan the 1st, Harun, the Caliph, ‘Isa ibn Ja’far and Ja’far ibn Yahya came to al-Madinah to visit the grave of the Holy Prophet, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause. Harun said to abu al-Hassan, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, ‘You go first.’ He (the Imam) abstained. Harun then moved forward, offered al- Salam and then moved to one side.

‘Isa ibn Ja’far then said to abu al-Hassan, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, ‘You go first.’ He (the Imam) abstained. ‘Isa then moved forward and offered al-Salam and then moved to one side alongside Harun. Ja’far then said to abu al-Hassan, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, ‘You go first.’ He (the Imam) abstained. Ja’far then moved forward, offered al-Salam, and then moved to one side alongside Harun.

Abu al-Hassan, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, then moved forward and said, ‘(I hereby declare, affirm and acknowledge that you are a ‘Alayhi al-Salam and my) submission to (your commandments) O my father. I appeal before Allah, who chose you, selected you, guided you and guided through you to grant salawat (favors and compensation to you worthy of Your services to Allah’s cause).’
Harun said to ‘Isa, ‘Did you hear what he said?’ He replied, ‘Yes, I heard what he said.’ Harun then said, ‘I testify that he (the Messenger of Allah) is indeed his father.’”
